import sys

def main():
    R = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    for i in range(1, R + 1):
        leading_spaces = ' ' * (R - i)
        first_part = ''.join(chr(65 + j) for j in range(i))
        second_part = first_part[:-1][::-1]
        line = leading_spaces + first_part + second_part
        print(line)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
